notes.title: 🎮 MEGA UPDATE IS HERE! 🎮
notes.content:
This massive patch brings major improvements across the board, with a strong focus on performance optimization and gameplay polish for the entire Barcha experience.

What’s New:

🔪 +2 Hours of New Gameplay!
Dive into the all-new "Purple Action" storyline — set 15 years after the terrifying events of Barcha. Discover what happened next in this haunting new chapter...

🛡️ New Mini-Game Added!
Try the new Tank Movement Mini-Game with a fixed-camera, retro-inspired style — a unique third storyline to test your nerves and reflexes!

⚙️ Improved Performance & Visual Polish
We’ve gone under the hood to clean up bugs, smooth out the experience, and make the horror hit harder than ever.
[hr][/hr]
🎉 Enjoy the update, and don’t forget to like, comment, and share your thoughts.
💀 Thank you all so much for the amazing support — it means everything![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536906/1e628a6b1f5d3dc9e80051a2120e8552a9629061.jpg"]

notes.title: Update v2 Is Here – A Whole New Game Experience!
notes.content:
Scenario Enhancements
Story matters – and we’ve spent time refining the narrative elements across the board. Expect deeper lore, sharper dialogue, more immersive world-building, and better storytelling that ties everything together with new impact and clarity.

Performance Boosts
You asked, we listened. We’ve optimized the game under the hood to improve performance across all supported platforms. Smoother gameplay, reduced load times, and better stability mean fewer interruptions and more time enjoying the action.

notes.title: Major update version 1.2 live
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that Version 1.2 of Barcha is now live! 🎉

What’s New in This Update?
✅ Gameplay Improvements – Smoother mechanics and enhanced performance.
✅ Lighting & Post-Processing Fixes – Better visuals for a more immersive experience.

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy the latest update! Let us know your feedback.

See you in the game! 🎮✨

notes.title: New Update: Skip Story Button Added!
notes.content:
We’ve listened to your feedback, and we're excited to announce that we've added a "Skip Story" button in the game! We noticed that some players prefer to skip longer story sections, so now you can easily move forward without missing a beat.

We hope this makes your experience even better, and we appreciate your continued support!

notes.title: Major update
notes.content:
After thorough testing by our team and valuable feedback from several curators, we’re excited to announce that Barcha will be receiving a major update. This update will include:

Performance improvements

New levels and characters

Enhanced storylines

Increased interactivity

As a result, the game’s release will be delayed. We appreciate your understanding and patience as we work to deliver the best possible experience!
